rows.liveDriver: EIA weekly regular gasoline calendar-month average $4.355/gal vs prior $4.058/gal using 4 weekly prints
rows.scaffoldDriver: free fallback: recent CPI-timed movement + same-month seasonal average

rows.name: Used cars and trucks
rows.liveDriver: SETA02 SA model: rho 0.47 * prior CPI SA +0.37 pp + Manheim m0, m2 signal -0.48 pp * volatility scale 0.35 + level gap z=-0.69, mean-reversion adj +0.01 pp; timing m0 2026-09 -1.10% pub 2026-10-07; m2 2026-07 -1.36% pub 2026-08-07. Compared against CUSR0000SETA02; no asymmetry term kept. SA forecast converted to NSA using the component's historical SA/NSA offset.
rows.scaffoldDriver: free fallback: recent CPI-timed movement + same-month seasonal average

rows.name: Airline fares
rows.liveDriver: airfare fallback -0.87% plus guarded jet-fuel pass-through 2.09% from EIA Gulf Coast jet fuel calendar-month average $4.374/gal vs prior $3.724/gal using 20 daily prints
rows.scaffoldDriver: free fallback: recent CPI-timed movement + same-month seasonal average

rows.name: Other motor fuels
